newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany set to simplify salary payment in shares.
newsitem.headline: Germany set to simplify salary payment in shares.

text.p: Germany's managers should soon find it easier to be paid in share options under a new proposal currently being considered by the German justice ministry, a Government spokesman said on Monday.

Ulrich Seibert, an official from the justice ministry, said a proposal to facilitate easier payment through share options was being considered which would change legislation governing share law in Germany.
Speaking at a conference organised by the German share institute, DAI, Seibert said how companies had been forced to use "crutches" to get around the current legislation.
The new law was part of a new package of changes to legislation regarding shares which the Bonn Government would hopefully pass soon, said Seibert.
